sources.games: 656 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats), win 45.3%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py bristleback.
sources.player: Player review, 2026-10-20: no Spirit Vessel for offlaners against heavy healing (a support's item); Linken's Sphere for Queen of Pain, Puck, Void Spirit and Storm Spirit against Phantom Assassin and Spirit Breaker, not Slark; Axe levels Battle Hunger second; Templar Assassin keeps Meld > Psi Blades > Refraction.

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: bracer 74% (2), magic_wand 76% (6), vanguard 36% (6), soul_ring 62% (8), power_treads 91% (9), pers 62% (13), consecrated_wraps 49% (16), lotus_orb 55% (17), aghanims_shard 97% (18), sange 84% (21), yasha 82% (24), sange_and_yasha 81% (24), black_king_bar 42% (27), heart 37% (31), buckler 23% (32).

tempo.basis: Gold lines where the hero wins 80.0%+: 20:00 13000 (25 games, 80.0%), 25:00 15500 (79 games, 81.0%), 30:00 21500 (19 games, 84.2%); net worth ~0.96 of that gold; points under 20 games left out.
